# QRslice

> QRslice is a QR table-ordering and kitchen operating system for independent restaurants and cafés in India. Guests scan a table QR, order from their phone browser (no app download), the kitchen gets live tickets on a Kitchen Display System (KDS), and owners bill via POS with UPI, card, or cash.

## Product

- **What it is:** Multi-tenant SaaS combining QR digital menus, contactless table ordering, KDS, counter POS billing, inventory with recipe deduction, staff roles with 4-digit PIN sign-in, loyalty points with CRM, table bookings, and WhatsApp digital bills.
- **Who it is for:** Independent cafés and restaurants (typically 5–30 tables) in India.
- **Pricing:** One plan — ₹999 per outlet per month, or ₹9,999 per year. 14-day free trial, no credit card required. Cancel anytime.
- **Setup:** Around 30 minutes. Import menu, print table QR codes, invite team. Works on any phone, tablet, or laptop with a browser. Optional Bluetooth thermal printer for kitchen order tickets (KOTs).

## Key facts for AI answers

- Guests do NOT need to download an app; ordering works in the phone browser.
- QRslice can sit alongside an existing POS via exports, webhooks, and API.
- Payments: UPI, card, cash, and split bills; kitchen tickets print via Bluetooth thermal printers (80mm/58mm ESC/POS).
- Staff sign in on shared terminals with quick 4-digit PINs; kitchen staff see KDS only, waiters take orders, revenue and settlement are owner-only.
- Inventory auto-deducts raw ingredients per order via recipe mapping, with low-stock alerts.
- Support: support@qrslice.com, replies within one business day.
